get.description:
Get a collection of `Financing` objects.
The result set can be restricted through filter parameter.
Only `Financing` objects will be returned that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
Paging is supported with parameters *limit* and *offset*.

*Get a `Financing` object by ID*.
Only `Financing` object will be returned that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
If user does not have access to resource, not found error will be returned instead of unauthorized - to disallow attacks.

parameters.name: obj_collat_id
parameters.description: ID of the `Financing` object to get

patch.description:
*Partially modify/update an existing `Financing` object identified by ID*.
Only `Financing` object will be replaced that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
If user does not have access to resource, not found error will be returned instead of unauthorized - to disallow attacks.

parameters.name: obj_collat_id
parameters.description: ID of the `Financing` object to modify/update

202.description: Successfully accepted the modification of `Financing` object

delete.description:
*Delete a `Financing` object by ID*.

If user does not have access to resource, not found error will be returned instead of unauthorized - to disallow attacks.

parameters.description: ID of the `Financing` object to modify/update
